title: Vega
subtitle: Three stones. Three chapters. Diamond for clarity. Rubies for passion. The tension between them is the point.
description: At the centre sits a cushion-cut diamond, soft-cornered and brilliance-first — the kind of stone you notice before you understand why, built to catch light from every angle and hold it. Two rubies flank it, burning against the clear centre so the ring reads as a study in contrast: clarity beside heat, restraint beside intensity. The tension between the diamond and the rubies is the whole design, and it is not a ring that whispers. Set in eighteen-karat white gold, three stones, three registers of light.
